settings.name: Sky Realty
settings.tagline: Homes for sale and rent in Ashby Harbor, from the people who live here.
settings.heroTitle: Find your place in Ashby Harbor
settings.heroText: Houses, condos and lofts across six neighborhoods, from the waterfront to the pines. Search, save and book a viewing in a minute.
settings.aboutText: Sky Realty is an independent agency of six agents who live in the neighborhoods we sell. We price honestly, answer the same day and walk every home before we list it.
settings.sellText: Tell us about your home and an agent who sells in your neighborhood will send a free valuation within two working days, with recent sales nearby.
settings.disclaimer: Estimates only. Your lender will give you the exact rate and payment.

areas.name: Old Harbor
areas.blurb: Brick lofts, cafés and the waterfront promenade, a short walk from the ferry.
areas.text: The oldest part of Ashby Harbor wraps around the bay: converted warehouses, narrow streets of row houses and the Saturday market on the quay. Most homes are condos and lofts within a ten-minute walk of the ferry and the train.

areas.name: Riverside
areas.blurb: Family streets along the river path, with the best-rated primary school in town.
areas.text: Tree-lined streets of craftsman and bungalow homes run down to the river path. Riverside has two parks, the town library and an easy bike ride to downtown along the water.

areas.name: Hillcrest
areas.blurb: Larger homes on quiet curving roads, with views over the bay.
areas.text: Hillcrest climbs the slopes north of downtown. Homes are larger, gardens deeper and many upper floors look out over the harbor. It is quiet, green and ten minutes by car from the center.

areas.name: Pine Hollow
areas.blurb: Cottages and farmhouses among the pines, with trails from the back door.
areas.text: On the wooded west side of town, Pine Hollow mixes cottages, farmhouses and newer homes on generous lots. Trails lead into the state forest, and the farm stand on Hollow Road opens every summer weekend.

areas.name: North Point
areas.blurb: Waterfront homes and modern houses on the peninsula, near the lighthouse.
areas.text: North Point is the peninsula at the north end of the bay. Many homes have their own dock or a path to the beach, and the lighthouse park is at the tip. The sailing club and the marina are here too.

areas.name: The Meadows
areas.blurb: Newer neighborhoods with townhouses, ranch homes and big back yards.
areas.text: Built over the last twenty years on former farmland east of downtown, The Meadows has townhouses, ranch homes and modern family houses, the sports park and the shopping center on Meadow Parkway.

agents.name: Grace Holloway
agents.title: Managing broker
agents.bio: Grace opened Sky Realty's Ashby Harbor office and still lists homes every week. She knows Hillcrest and North Point street by street, and is known for straight talk about pricing.

agents.name: Marcus Reed
agents.title: Senior agent
agents.bio: Marcus grew up in Old Harbor and helps first-time buyers find their footing downtown. Before real estate he was a contractor, so he will tell you what an inspection is likely to find.

agents.name: Priya Natarajan
agents.title: Buyer specialist
agents.bio: Priya works with families moving to Ashby Harbor for the schools. She plans viewings around nap times and school runs and answers messages late into the evening.

agents.name: Daniel Ortega
agents.title: Listing agent
agents.bio: Daniel prepares homes for sale: staging, photos, the right price on the first day. He specializes in the farmhouses and cottages of Pine Hollow.

agents.name: Hannah Price
agents.title: Rentals manager
agents.bio: Hannah looks after rentals, from studio lofts to family homes. Landlords trust her with tenant checks; tenants like that she replies the same day.

agents.name: Owen Fitzgerald
agents.title: Waterfront specialist
agents.bio: A lifelong sailor, Owen knows every dock, seawall and flood map on the bay. If a home has water views or water access, he has probably been inside it.
